in_english.name: Jehan
in_english.long_meaning: Jehan is derived from the Arabic root 'j-h-w' which means 'to encompass' or 'to surround'. The name signifies the world, universe, or all existence. It appears in the Quran in Surah Yasin verse 36 and Surah Al-Furqan verse 2. The name symbolizes vastness and inclusiveness, reflecting the comprehensive nature of the universe.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jehan is prominent in various aspects of Islamic culture, particularly in Persian literature and history. The name itself connotes the idea of a divine blessing or gift, making it a desirable and revered name. Historically, many notable figures with this name have left a lasting impact on Islamic civilization. Hafiz Jehangir, for instance, was a celebrated Persian poet and philosopher whose poems continue to be read and cherished in the Islamic world. Jehangir, the Mughal Emperor, is renowned for his patronage of the arts and his expansive territorial conquests, which saw the flourishing of Islamic culture and the construction of magnificent architectural and artistic landmarks.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Jehan carries a deep spiritual significance, as it reflects the belief in the ultimate source of all blessings and gifts - God. The name emphasizes the idea of receiving what comes directly from the divine, instilling a sense of gratefulness and humility in the bearer. In Islamic spirituality, the ultimate goal is to recognize the source of all blessings as God and to live in accordance with His will. The name Jehan reminds the bearer of the divine presence and the blessings that come from acknowledging and pleasing God. It is a constant reminder of God's immense generosity and His lavish gifts, making it an inspirational and uplifting name.
